newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank says undecided on preferred stock issue.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank says undecided on preferred stock issue.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd said on Friday it had not made any decision on a preferred stock issue.
""We are considering (an issue), but we have not decided anything on it," a Fuji Bank spokesman said.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday that the bank had decided to issue about 210 billion yen worth of preferred stock on the overseas market in December.
The paper said the move was aimed at boosting the bank's capital, which has fallen due to write-offs of bad loans last business year.
